text.arabic_uthmani: فَأَخَذْنَٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌۭ

words.gloss_range: sequential and causal connector that moves the prior rejection directly into punishment
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) makes ayah 40 open as consequence, not as a detached report. The seizure follows Pharaoh's prior rejection across the ayah boundary with both sequence and cause still audible. Because the particle is prefixed to the first verb, the connector, boundary hinge, and first punishment beat arrive as one compressed start; its pairing with the later connector gives the ayah a clipped seizure-then-casting movement before the final verdict.

topics.headline: boundary consequence after rejection
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah boundary behaves as a causal hinge from rejection to seizure, not as a fresh episode break.
topics.reason: The particle is identified as sequential or causal, and the first verbal clause follows the prior speech scene as the next forced action.

topics.headline: prefixed launch of first punishment beat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah begin with motion already attached to the verb, before a new subject or name is restated.
topics.reason: The proclitic connector is fused to the opening verb, matching the first verbal clause of the action sequence.

topics.headline: first half of double connector architecture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears seizure and casting as two rapid divine beats that prepare the final moral clause.
topics.reason: The ayah has two prefixed sequential connectors before the two perfect verbs, then shifts to a circumstantial nominal clause.

words.gloss_range: completed divine seizure of Pharaoh as a direct object, already carrying punitive taking rather than neutral acquisition
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes taking, grasping, seizing, and accountability or punishment uses; the local perfect verb selects punitive seizure
words.prose: {{ar:أَخَذْنَٰهُ}} ({{tr:akhadhnāhu}}) compresses divine agency and Pharaoh as patient into one completed verb. The suffix keeps the target continuous with the preceding accusation scene while the singular object makes Pharaoh the first seized figure before the armies are added. The root is locally narrowed to punitive seizure: the action is not neutral taking, but a tactile taking-to-task that belongs to the Pharaoh destruction formula (28:40) and the same-surah punishment series (51:44).

topics.headline: singular target carried across boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks Pharaoh from the prior verse into this ayah without needing his name repeated, and sees him seized before the plural expansion.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence resolves the object suffix to Pharaoh and shows the following army noun coordinated after that singular object.

topics.headline: completed divine agency inside the verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the register shift from human accusation to completed divine action through the verb morphology itself.
topics.reason: The perfect verb carries first-person plural agency and a direct object suffix, so agency and patient are both inside the surface word.

topics.headline: punitive seizure rather than neutral taking
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the action as grasping punishment and accountability, while broader taking branches are not made independently active.
topics.reason: The local perfect verb with a direct object and the following casting into the sea select punitive seizure; the broad root range is retained only as narrowed pressure.

topics.headline: seizure in Pharaoh and punishment networks
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the verb as part of a larger punishment pattern, especially the Pharaoh formula (28:40) and the nearby punishment recurrence (51:44).
topics.reason: The local co-occurrence with armies, casting, and sea matches the CRITICAL cross-reference pattern and is not contradicted by grammar.

topics.headline: first action beat and rough sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the transition from speech to physical seizure as the first hard beat of the ayah.
topics.reason: The verb stands immediately after the opening connector and begins the first verbal clause.

words.gloss_range: coordinating connector that brings Pharaoh's armies into the object field of the seizure
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) is the small hinge that widens the seized object. It coordinates the armies with Pharaoh's object suffix, so they are not scenery after the ruler but are drawn into the same seizure beat. An accompaniment nuance survives only within that coordination: the forces go with their commander into his fate, while the local syntax still makes them part of the object field.

topics.headline: armies coordinated as co-object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Pharaoh's forces are grammatically seized with him, not merely mentioned beside him.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence coordinates the army noun with the object suffix of the first verb.

topics.headline: accompaniment inside coordination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can feel the armies accompanying Pharaoh into punishment, while local syntax keeps coordination as the main parse.
topics.reason: The accompaniment payoff is coherent, but the explicit attachment evidence licenses the noun as coordinated with the direct object.

topics.headline: pivot from ruler to apparatus
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees one connector expand the scene from an individual ruler to the military apparatus attached to him.
topics.reason: The proclitic connector introduces the army noun immediately after the singular object verb.

words.gloss_range: his organized forces or hosts, possessively bound to Pharaoh and included as an accusative object of seizure
words.root_gloss_range: root range centers on gathered forces, troops, and helpers, with unrelated stony-ground and name/place branches not active here
words.prose: {{ar:جُنُودَهُۥ}} ({{tr:junūdahū}}) names organized forces as Pharaoh's own apparatus. The possessive suffix identifies the hosts through him, so their destruction follows the authority they served rather than treating them as a loose crowd. Their accusative coordination makes them part of the seizure, and the plural host noun then prepares the later plural object in the casting. The word also keeps the Pharaoh-host formula visible across retellings (26:60, 28:6, 28:39-40).

topics.headline: hosts bound to Pharaoh by suffix
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the armies are identified through Pharaoh, making his apparatus fall with his authority.
topics.reason: The possessive suffix is syntactically forced and resolves to Pharaoh; the lexical field supports forces or helpers as the local branch.

topics.headline: accusative inclusion in seizure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the armies included in the first verb's object field before the plural casting resumes them.
topics.reason: The noun is accusative and coordinated with the object suffix of the first verb.

topics.headline: organized host rather than loose crowd
topics.reader_payoff: The reader understands the punished group as structured military force, not a random collection of people.
topics.reason: Dictionary evidence keeps the active branch at gathered forces or hosts, while unrelated stony-ground and name branches are not local.

topics.headline: Pharaoh-host destruction formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader places the army noun inside the recurring Pharaoh-host collapse pattern, including the sea scene (28:40).
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows tie the host noun to Pharaoh retellings, and local grammar supplies the same commander-host relation.

topics.headline: singular object expanded into plural disposal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees how the singular seizure plus army noun becomes the plural object of the next verb.
topics.reason: Translation support explicitly links the later plural suffix to Pharaoh and his soldiers together.

topics.headline: sound handoff from accusation to army collapse
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the boundary movement from the accusation in 51:39 into the collapse of the concrete force behind the accuser.
topics.reason: The sound and boundary rows are coherent as cadence observations and do not alter the local parse.

words.gloss_range: second sequential-result connector that moves from seizure into immediate casting
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) makes the second action follow with no pause. The particle is resultative as well as sequential: seizure immediately becomes disposal. Its prefixing to the casting verb repeats the opening connector pattern, so the ayah's middle does not restart the story but drives the first punishment beat into the second.

topics.headline: resultative zero-gap sequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that casting is the immediate result of seizure, not a later separate episode.
topics.reason: The second connector links the next verbal clause to the seizure clause as sequential consequence.

topics.headline: prefixed pivot into casting verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the connector enter the casting action at the surface of the word, turning seizure into disposal.
topics.reason: The particle is proclitic before the second perfect verb and begins the second verbal clause.

topics.headline: second half of double connector cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the two divine acts as matching rapid beats: first seizure, then casting.
topics.reason: The two connectors frame the two perfect verbs and support the repeated cadence noted by the CRITICAL rows.

words.gloss_range: completed divine casting away of the gathered plural object, with contemptuous discard and a governed destination phrase
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes casting away, repudiating, withdrawing aside, remnants, and infusion-related derivatives; the local verb selects outward contemptuous disposal
words.prose: {{ar:نَبَذْنَٰهُمْ}} ({{tr:nabadhnāhum}}) turns the seized singular-plus-armies unit into a plural object and casts them away. The verb carries a contemptuous discard image, not a neutral motion verb: the sovereign apparatus becomes refuse thrown into its endpoint. The governed destination phrase keeps the action aimed into the sea, and the root-family rows are narrowed to this local outward disposal; covenant-casting reversals (2:101, 3:187) and the Pharaoh formula (28:40) sharpen the scene without replacing the local grammar.

topics.headline: plural object gathers Pharaoh and hosts
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees Pharaoh and his armies become one plural patient of disposal after the first clause separated them.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence resolves the plural suffix to the coordinated object from the first clause.

topics.headline: casting governs destination phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the casting is not left open-ended; it is directed into the sea as a fixed endpoint.
topics.reason: The verb has a direct object and a governed prepositional complement with the sea noun.

topics.headline: contemptuous discard selected locally
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the punished collective as thrown away with contempt, while unrelated root branches are not made active.
topics.reason: V4 supports the casting-away branch; the local transitive verb plus destination selects outward discard and narrows wider branch claims.

topics.headline: rejection reversed onto rejecters
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees covenant-casting and put-aside associations return as reversal pressure on the rejecters, while the local action remains physical disposal.
topics.reason: The wider root family includes repudiation and infusion-related casting, but the local frame does not select those as independent senses.

topics.headline: two-step seizure and casting formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the punishment as a two-step motion, matching the Pharaoh destruction formula (28:40).
topics.reason: The co-occurrence and clause structure place this verb after seizure and before the sea endpoint.

topics.headline: same-surah extraction versus ejection
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a same-surah contrast between removal for rescue (51:35) and ejection for punishment here.
topics.reason: The row gives a concrete same-surah contrast and local grammar does not contradict it.

topics.headline: lengthened form and abrupt ejection sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the divine verb form stretch and then end in the rough texture of ejection.
topics.reason: The sound and surface-form observations are local to the verb and do not change its syntax.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking the sea as the container or destination into which the casting lands
words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) is the preposition that keeps the casting headed into a container, not merely near a place. It governs the sea noun and makes the middle beat remain open until the destination is named. Its separate word position lets the trajectory be seen before the endpoint arrives, while the recitation liaison with the following noun tightens the phrase audibly.

topics.headline: into the containing sea
topics.reader_payoff: The reader understands the sea phrase as engulfing destination, not loose location or contact.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the sea noun as the complement of the casting verb.

topics.headline: trajectory held open before endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the action pivot into place before the endpoint closes the second beat.
topics.reason: The preposition stands as its own word between the casting verb and governed sea noun.

topics.headline: audible liaison into endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the preposition run into the following known sea phrase as one destination unit.
topics.reason: The sound observation matches the immediate preposition-plus-governed-noun sequence.

words.gloss_range: the known Pharaoh-story sea as the governed endpoint of the casting, with literal engulfing water and destination force
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes aiming or intending, dry-ablution seeking, and sea or great water; the local definite noun selects the sea branch while destination pressure remains relevant
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْيَمِّ}} ({{tr:al-yammi}}) closes the disposal trajectory with the known Pharaoh-story sea. The definite, genitive, singular noun is not countable water in general; it is the recognized endpoint that receives the discarded collective. The word keeps literal engulfing water in view while narrowing the wider root field: aiming or direction pressure helps the noun feel like a targeted endpoint, but the local branch is sea. It also brings the drowning formula across Pharaoh passages (7:136, 20:78, 28:40), with a reversal from Moses' rescue setting (28:7) to Pharaoh's destruction (28:40).

topics.headline: known governed endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader lands the casting in the known sea of the Pharaoh narrative, not an unspecified body of water.
topics.reason: The noun is definite, genitive under the preposition, and functions as the endpoint of the casting phrase.

topics.headline: literal sea with engulfing pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the endpoint as a vast engulfing medium, while the local noun remains a literal sea rather than free metaphor.
topics.reason: V4 supports the sea or great-water branch, and the local prepositional phrase selects a physical endpoint.

topics.headline: direction pressure under sea noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses destination and deliberate aiming in the root field, while dry-ablution or general intending branches are not selected here.
topics.reason: The root includes aiming and dry-ablution branches, but the local definite noun selects the sea branch; direction survives only as endpoint pressure.

topics.headline: Pharaoh drowning formula across passages
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the noun as the fixed sea term of Pharaoh's destruction across passages (7:136, 20:78, 28:40).
topics.reason: The distribution rows and local grammar both tie the noun to the Pharaoh sea scene.

topics.headline: rescue sea becomes destruction sea
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the same sea field reverse from Moses' rescue context (28:7) to Pharaoh's destruction context (28:40).
topics.reason: The row gives concrete references and the local Pharaoh destruction setting supports the contrast.

topics.headline: preposition and sea joined audibly
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the preposition and sea bind as one destination phrase.
topics.reason: The governed noun immediately follows the preposition.

words.gloss_range: circumstantial connector that appends a simultaneous moral-state clause to the casting
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) turns the ayah from disposal to verdict without adding another action. As a circumstantial connector, it makes Pharaoh's blameworthiness simultaneous with the casting: the physical destruction and moral evaluation occupy the same grammatical breath. The concessive contrast remains narrowed inside that function, so the clause can feel like "while/even as" without ceasing to be a state clause. The same-surah punishment-state pattern returns at 51:44.

topics.headline: circumstantial verdict clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final clause as Pharaoh's state during punishment, not as a third event.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the nominal clause as circumstantial and linked to the casting action.

topics.headline: contrast inside circumstance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels a contrast between being physically cast away and already bearing moral blame, while the local function remains circumstantial.
topics.reason: The contrast payoff is compatible with the circumstantial clause but does not override its syntactic role.

topics.headline: pivot from place to verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah soften from hard action into compact moral predication.
topics.reason: The connector is prefixed to the independent pronoun opening the nominal clause.

topics.headline: same-surah punishment-state pattern
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final state clause participate in a local pattern of punishment described with simultaneous state clauses (51:44).
topics.reason: The concrete same-surah parallel uses another state clause at the moment of punishment.

words.gloss_range: independent singular pronoun that re-isolates Pharaoh as the subject of the final verdict
words.prose: {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) pulls the ayah back from the plural object to Pharaoh alone. After the plural casting suffix, the independent singular pronoun blocks the final predicate from drifting onto the army as a whole and gives the verdict a stable subject. Its detached form contrasts with the attached object suffixes, making individual culpability visible after collective punishment. The nominal clause marks blame as his standing state during the action, not another action in the sequence.

topics.headline: explicit singular bearer of blame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the final blame falls on Pharaoh specifically, even after the plural group has been cast away.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence resolves the independent pronoun to Pharaoh and makes it the subject of the final predicate.

topics.headline: nominal state during punishment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader treats blameworthiness as Pharaoh's asserted state during punishment, while avoiding an overclaim that the grammar alone proves timeless permanence.
topics.reason: The final clause is nominal and circumstantial; it marks state rather than a new finite action.

topics.headline: singular-plural-singular pronoun arc
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the ayah's accountability pattern: individual seizure, collective casting, individual verdict.
topics.reason: The suffixes and independent pronoun form the distribution described by the CRITICAL rows, and attachment evidence resolves their referents.

words.gloss_range: indefinite nominative predicate meaning blameworthy in a self-incurred, active-participle sense
words.root_gloss_range: root range centers on blame, reproach, censure, mutual blame, and self-incurred culpability, with delay or lingering branches not active here
words.prose: {{ar:مُلِيمٌۭ}} ({{tr:mulīmun}}) is the final predicate, so the ayah closes by naming Pharaoh's moral condition. Its nominative indefinite shape makes blameworthiness an asserted quality rather than a title. The active-participle form narrows the blame field toward self-incurred culpability: he is not merely a passive recipient of censure, but one who has made himself blameworthy. The word also resonates with the sea-casting description of Jonah (37:142), with the same label in a different outcome, and it answers the prior accusation scene (51:39) by turning the final verdict back onto the accuser.

topics.headline: indefinite nominative predicate quality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final word as an asserted quality of Pharaoh in the circumstantial clause, not as another object, action, or title.
topics.reason: The word is nominative and indefinite as predicate of the independent pronoun in the nominal state clause.

topics.headline: active participle of self-incurred blame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees Pharaoh as the agent of his own culpability, not merely someone upon whom blame is externally placed.
topics.reason: V4 supports the blame branch, and the local active-participle predicate selects self-incurred blame over passive blame.

topics.headline: marked blame thread in the surah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this marked blame word opens a local blame thread that later contrasts with another blame form (51:54).
topics.reason: The root is low-occurrence in this form and the row gives a concrete same-surah echo.

topics.headline: Jonah sea-casting contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader compares two sea-casting scenes marked by the same blame label, Jonah (37:142) and Pharaoh here, and notices the sharply different outcomes.
topics.reason: The inter-ayah rows provide a concrete parallel at 37:142, and the local sea-casting setting makes the contrast relevant.

topics.headline: final moral seal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the final sound and final word as the moral explanation of the seizure and casting.
topics.reason: The word closes the ayah as predicate of the final clause and returns to the opening singular target.

topics.headline: accusation answered by self-condemnation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the accusation from 51:39 reversed into a final verdict of self-incurred blame on Pharaoh.
topics.reason: The boundary rows connect the prior accusation scene to the closing predicate without altering the local parse.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The linked taking of the ruler with his troops, casting of the resulting plural into the sea, and circumstantial blame clause.
baseline_models.mechanism: Accountability becomes physical capture of a ruler together with his mutually supporting apparatus; casting then removes the whole formation from standing or consideration into an overwhelming medium, while the final clause marks culpability rather than mere defeat.

activation_trace.role: Taking as answerability supplies the judicial basis for the capture.
A mutually reinforcing collective makes the object of judgment an apparatus, not an isolated man.
Throwing away supplies decisive removal from both place and regard.
The vast water supplies a medium capable of engulfing the entire formation.
Deserved reproach identifies the seizure as culpability realized in an outcome.

changed_reading.before: A ruler and his soldiers are physically drowned.
changed_reading.after: A culpable ruler and the support system that sustains him are judicially seized and discarded as one object.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The shift from the singular object in the first verb, through the attached troops, to the plural object in the second verb.
baseline_models.mechanism: The leader and his organized supporters enter the seizure as distinguishable terms but leave it as one handled plural. Capture therefore collapses hierarchy: the collective that magnified the ruler can no longer keep him apart from its fate.

activation_trace.role: Collective mutual aid supplies the cohesion that the pronoun sequence collapses.
Capture makes ruler and supporters jointly controllable.
Removal to a side turns a ranked formation into a marginalized remainder.

changed_reading.before: Leader and army merely undergo the same event.
changed_reading.after: The event actively abolishes their internal hierarchy and rebundles the ruler with his own support as one disposable mass.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The rapid fa-linked sequence ending in the sea noun from the root of deliberate aiming.
baseline_models.mechanism: The sea remains literal great water, but its root also activates directed intention. Beside the casting verb, this makes the destination feel selected and aimed at rather than accidental.

activation_trace.role: The throw supplies forceful transfer away from the prior position.
Deliberate aiming turns the following water destination into the selected terminus of the transfer.
Great water keeps the directional activation anchored in the noun's actual setting.

changed_reading.before: They happen to end up in the sea after being cast.
changed_reading.after: The compressed action deliberately aims the seized formation at a chosen terminal medium.

context_deltas.mechanism: An envoy is dispatched toward the ruler with a compelling, manifest warrant; the ruler turns away by means of a strong supporting side. The focus seizure then includes that supporting side and publicly terminates the failed counter-position.

activation_trace.role: Dispatch supplies the initiating movement toward the ruler.
A compelling warrant makes the encounter a contest of justified authority.
Manifestness removes obscurity as an explanation for the ruler's response.
Turning away supplies the ruler's chosen counter-movement.
A strong side identifies the support on which that counter-movement depends.
Accountable seizure answers the rejection of the manifest warrant.
The support collective is captured with the authority it had reinforced.
Open rupture supplies a public and adversarial close to the rejected encounter.

structural_cues: The movement toward the ruler in 51:38 is answered by his turning in 51:39 and the two rapid fa-linked acts in 51:40.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dispatch, compelling warrant, visible proof, dependent turning, capture, and open rupture; I infer a reversal from rival authority to exposed dependence. A live alternative is that the first two ayat only explain culpability without making authority reversal the mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The focus reports punishment after an unspecified conflict.
changed_reading.after: The seizure is the reversal of a failed counter-authority: the ruler rejects a warranted approach through his support, so both ruler and support are removed together.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same turning root frames two agents: the ruler turns away with support and is blameworthy at seizure, while the messenger is later told to turn away and is explicitly not blameworthy before continuing to remind. Blame therefore tracks response to the warning, not the bare motion of withdrawal.

activation_trace.role: The first withdrawal is supported rejection.
Deserved reproach marks the moral state of the first withdrawing agent.
The second withdrawal repeats the motion under a different moral assignment.
Negated reproach creates the explicit polarity with the focus clause.
Renewed reminder shows that absolved withdrawal is compatible with continued warning.

structural_cues: 51:39 and 51:54 repeat withdrawal around the opposed blame predicates of 51:40 and 51:54.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the mirrored withdrawals, positive blame, negated blame, and resumed reminder; I infer that the focus clause is the hinge distributing responsibility by relation to warning. The alternative is a local reassurance in 51:54 with no retrospective force.

changed_reading.before: The final clause simply adds a negative trait to the drowned ruler.
changed_reading.after: The clause becomes the moral hinge of a mirror: withdrawal is culpable when it rejects warranted warning, but not when duty has been discharged.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following sequence supplies another sent element that is sterile, transforms what it reaches into decayed remainder, and is followed by repeated seizure whose victims cannot rise or obtain aid. This makes the sea-casting of a mutually supporting army a compact instance of de-formation: cohesion becomes inert remainder and incapacity.

activation_trace.role: Moving air supplies a second elemental medium of punishment beside the sea.
Sterility makes the dispatched element produce no sustaining remainder.
Transformation supplies the directional change from organized thing to ruined state.
Decay supplies the terminal material image for de-formation.
The army supplies the organized cohesion that can be undone.
Repeated capture links the neighboring punishment directly to the focus action.
Bodily rising supplies the capacity explicitly removed after seizure.
Aid supplies the social capacity that an army should provide but cannot.

structural_cues: 51:41-42 moves from a sent element to total material transformation; 51:44 repeats seizure and 51:45 negates both rising and aid.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies elemental media, sterile transformation, decay, repeated capture, and failed rising and aid; I infer that these details retrospectively expose the focus army's de-formation. The alternative is a series of separate punishment vignettes with no shared material mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The army is a set of persons killed by water.
changed_reading.after: The mutually supporting formation is unmade by an elemental medium until neither its structure nor its expected capacities remain.

context_deltas.mechanism: Limited enjoyment and a bounded time precede the command not to hasten, followed by a threatened appointed day. The focus's rapid seizure is therefore the compressed arrival of an already delimited term, not impulsive force.

activation_trace.role: Extended but finite enjoyment supplies respite before the terminal action.
A bounded time supplies the limit governing respite.
Accountable seizure is reread as execution when the bounded term arrives.
Negated haste distinguishes certainty from premature execution.
A delimited duration supplies the final horizon.
An appointment binds threat to a specified temporal realization.

structural_cues: The context spans respite until a term in 51:43, refusal of haste in 51:59, and the appointed day in 51:60, while 51:40 compresses realization into two fa-linked verbs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies finite respite, non-haste, and appointment; I infer that the focus's suddenness is narrated execution at maturity rather than lack of delay. The alternative is that the temporal language governs only the later addressees.

changed_reading.before: The seizure is an abrupt reaction.
changed_reading.after: Its abrupt surface is the moment a delayed but fixed accountability becomes executable.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the punishment sequence, the context foregrounds joining a structure, supporting it with strength, spreading and preparing a ground, measuring creation, and joining counterparts. Against these constructive operations, taking and casting the army reads as controlled disassembly of an illegitimate formation rather than undirected chaos.

activation_trace.role: The mutually supporting army supplies a constructed social formation.
Casting away supplies the corresponding disassembly operation.
Joining parts into a structure supplies the positive counter-operation.
Supporting strength distinguishes stable construction from the army's failed support.
Spreading and leveling supplies deliberate spatial preparation.
Preparation and ordering make the surrounding agency constructive as well as destructive.
Measured formation supplies control rather than randomness.
Joining counterparts supplies an ordered relation opposite to the army's collapsed cohesion.

structural_cues: The destruction examples of 51:38-46 are followed immediately by the constructive and ordering sequence of 51:47-49.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies social cohesion in the focus and constructive operations after it; I infer a build-disassemble contrast under one controlling agency. A live alternative is that the creation sequence only changes topic and does not qualify the earlier casting.

changed_reading.before: The sea-casting is sheer destructive force.
changed_reading.after: It is controlled disassembly by an agency whose surrounding acts display measured construction, support, and ordering.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command to flee toward God after clear warning creates a voluntary vector toward refuge. The focus root echo of aiming makes the ruler's cast into the sea the inverse vector: refusal to move toward refuge ends in being forcibly moved toward a terminal medium.

activation_trace.role: Casting supplies coerced movement away from the ruler's position.
Deliberate aiming lets the sea function as a selected vector endpoint.
Flight supplies the contrasting voluntary movement.
The worshipped destination makes voluntary flight movement toward refuge and allegiance.
Warning supplies the opportunity to choose the first vector before coercion.

structural_cues: The focus uses rapid fa-linked forced movement into a destination; 51:50 uses an imperative of flight toward a destination after the punishment sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies forced casting, an aiming root, voluntary flight, destination, and warning; I infer a contrast between chosen and imposed trajectories. The alternative keeps the sea root's aiming branch inactive and treats the two movements independently.

changed_reading.before: The sea is only where the punished ruler dies.
changed_reading.after: The ruler's forced trajectory becomes the negative foil to the hearer's still-open choice of a refugeward trajectory.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ruler appears with a collective whose members reinforce him; the later declaration denies any need for provision and locates composite strength and extended solidity in the acting deity. Taking the ruler with his troops thus exposes borrowed, dependent force before self-sufficient force.

activation_trace.role: Mutual reinforcement makes the ruler's force visibly dependent on a collective.
Negated desire supplies the absence of need from those addressed.
Allotted provision identifies a support the acting deity explicitly does not seek.
Strength composed like gathered strands supplies power that does not rely on the seized army.
Extended solidity supplies durable force in contrast to collapsed military cohesion.

structural_cues: The focus names the ruler together with his support collective; 51:57-58 explicitly negates received support and affirms strength.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dependent collective aid, no need for provision, and intrinsic strength and solidity; I infer that the seizure demonstrates a contrast in power architecture. The alternative reads 51:57-58 as doctrine without retrospective comment on the army.

changed_reading.before: A larger force defeats a ruler and his force.
changed_reading.after: The ruler's support-dependent power collapses when confronted by an agency whose power is not provisioned by supporters.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later repeated term for the wrongdoers' matching share also activates a full water-drawing vessel. Beside the focus's great water, this creates a contained material analogy: Pharaoh's immersion is one allotted draw from a larger reservoir of patterned judgment.

activation_trace.role: Great water supplies the reservoir side of the analogy.
Putting matters out of their proper place supplies the culpable class receiving the allotment.
An apportioned share supplies measured distribution across wrongdoers.
A full drawing vessel gives the share a water-linked material image.
Equivalence makes the allotment recurrent rather than unique.
Association groups the recipients into a comparable historical pattern.

structural_cues: 51:59 repeats the share term on both sides of an explicit comparison, after the focus has supplied a great-water judgment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies great water, a repeated apportioned share, its full-vessel branch, and explicit equivalence; I infer a reservoir-and-draw analogy linking the focus event to patterned allotment. The live alternative retains only the abstract sense of share and drops the water image.

changed_reading.before: Pharaoh's drowning is a self-contained historical fate.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is one measured allotment drawn from a recurrent reservoir of judgment shared by comparable wrongdoers.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links the accusation of magic and madness to a distant seizure branch and to the non-dominant mapping of the focus blame root. It remains anchored in the immediately preceding accusations, the exact focus roots, and the later repetition of the accusation; downstream prose should present it only as a recoil or shadow-image, never as a replacement for the ordinary senses of seizure and blame.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The seizure verb and final blame predicate immediately after the ruler's paired accusation.

activation_trace.role: Deceptive diversion supplies the first accusation made against the envoy.
Veiling of reason supplies the paired accusation.
A holding seizure associated with enchantment lets the accusation recoil onto the accuser's capture.
The non-dominant mapped branch supplies a faint madness-shadow in the accuser's terminal predicate.
Repetition shows the accusation to be a recurrent device rather than an isolated diagnosis.
The repeated paired label stabilizes the recoil pattern.

changed_reading.before: The ruler's accusations and his later seizure are unrelated details.
changed_reading.after: As a contained echo, the labels he projects return in the branch imagery of his own seizure and terminal state.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is cross-domain because it activates a water-holding basin and an infusion made by throwing material into a vessel. It remains valid as a material analogy anchored in all three focus roots and their actual great-water setting; downstream prose must call it an analogy of containment and loss of agency, not claim that the verse literally describes a basin or drink.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The sequence of taking, throwing, and entry into great water.

activation_trace.role: A place that retains water supplies the containing geometry.
Thrown material entering a liquid vessel makes the former agents passive contents of a medium.
Actual vast water anchors the container analogy in the focus scene.

changed_reading.before: The sea is a location surrounding still-distinct victims.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the sea becomes a containing medium into which the seized formation is added as passive, identity-losing contents.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant mapped gathering branch beneath a predicate ordinarily governed by blame. It stays anchored in the focus's collective noun, singular-to-plural handling, and exact split-root inventory; downstream prose should preserve deserved blame as primary and mention gathering only as an organizational undertone.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The ruler, attached troop collective, plural recoding, and final predicate.

activation_trace.role: A mutually supporting group supplies material initially gathered around the ruler.
Taking and collecting make ruler and support jointly held.
A single plural casting treats the gathered formation as one handled object.
The non-dominant gathering branch gives the blame predicate an organizational undertone.

changed_reading.before: The final predicate only names the ruler's moral fault.
changed_reading.after: Without displacing blame, it also shadows the fact that ruler and scattered supports have been gathered into one culpable, cast unit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it extends the troop collective functionally toward a repeated accusatory script. It remains anchored in the focus collective and in the context's exact repeated accusation, question of mutual bequest, and group transgression; downstream prose should call the script part of the ruler's support apparatus by analogy, not redefine the lexical noun as speech.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The troop collective as the ruler's mutually reinforcing support.

activation_trace.role: A mutually reinforcing body supplies the organizational pattern extended to rhetoric.
A saying circulating among people supplies the repeated verbal unit.
The magic label supplies one half of the standardized delegitimating formula.
The madness label completes the repeated formula.
Mutual transmission supplies the context's own model for apparent coordination across groups.
A human collective locates the script in group behavior.
Transgressive excess supplies the shared generator offered instead of literal coordination.

changed_reading.before: The ruler's forces are exhausted by armed personnel.
changed_reading.after: As a contained functional extension, his support apparatus also includes the reproducible rhetoric by which transgressive groups defend authority.

strongest_changes: The event becomes judicial disposal of a ruler together with the mutually reinforcing apparatus on which his rejection depends.
The blame clause becomes a hinge between culpable and absolved withdrawal rather than a detachable insult.
Neighboring elemental destruction and failed rising or aid recast drowning as the de-formation of organized capacity.
Later temporal and allotment language makes the rapid seizure a matured, patterned share of judgment rather than an impulsive episode.
summary.what_was_special: The focus compresses authority reversal, social collapse, material unmaking, directional coercion, and culpability into one short singular-to-plural movement. Split-root and vessel branches also preserve unusual but anchored echoes that a single consensus paraphrase would erase.
remaining_uncertainties: The aiming activation under the sea noun may be only etymological resonance rather than a live directional cue.
The build-disassemble contrast depends on reading the transition to 51:47-49 retrospectively.
The reservoir, accusation-recoil, gathered-predicate, and discursive-regiment readings are branch-distant analogies and must remain explicitly exploratory.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The support he relied on is seized with him.** `ء خ ذ/B003` supplies capture; `ج ن د/B001` gathered force of helpers; `ن ب ذ/B001` casting away; `ي م م/B003` great water; `ل و م/B001` blame. The singular seizure expands to ruler plus army, then plural casting. I infer **power-base included in liability -> collective removal into sea**. The verse reverses 51:39's reliance mechanism.
2. **Public blame replaces defensive attribution.** Pharaoh's speech labels the messenger in 51:39; now `ل و م/B001` directs reproach toward Pharaoh. I infer **false attribution -> event exposes responsible party -> blame reoriented**. The sea-casting supplies the public outcome that settles the contest of labels.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 51:54's “you are not blameworthy” produced a precise reversal: blame falls on the rejecter after proof, not on the warner after fulfilled delivery.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **The supported rejecter undergoes inverse extraction.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ء خ ذ/B002` is taking someone to account, with `B003` capture; fixed `ج ن د/B001` is a gathered force of helpers; fixed `ن ب ذ/B001` is casting or throwing away; fixed `ي م م/B003` is sea or great water; fixed `ل و م/B001` is blame for a blameworthy act. **Structural cue:** believers were caused to exit in 51:35, whereas Pharaoh turns by his support in 51:39; the next five ayat show sterile wind, total crumbling, bounded enjoyment, thunderbolt, and inability to rise. **Role and abduction:** capture gathers ruler and support into one object, casting discards that object into an engulfing medium, and blame supplies moral direction; I infer deliberate inversion of the earlier saving exit. **Reading change:** the army ceases to be protection and becomes part of the seized load whose own structure is thrown away.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 51:41–45 repeated the same terminal logic through wind, crumbling, expiry, thunderbolt, and failed rising, so the inverse extraction is one instance of systematic support-removal.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir kişiyi işlediği suç nedeniyle hesaba çekme ya da cezalandırma kalıbını açıkça bildirir. Dal, genel bir alma eylemi değil, kusur ile ona yöneltilen yaptırım arasındaki bağı doğru biçimde ayırır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişiye kendi suçu nedeniyle yaptırım uygulanmasını açıkça korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir kişiyi yakalayıp özgürlüğünden yoksun bırakarak tutsak etme eylemini ve bu eylemin sonucundaki kişiyi birlikte tanıklar. Dalın savaş veya zor kullanma bağlamındaki tutma çerçevesi bu ayrımı doğru korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, sıradan bir nesneyi almaktan farklı olarak bir kişiyi yakalayıp tutsak duruma getirmeyi anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tutsak kişi adı ile yakalama buyruğu ve kişi üzerinde kurulan kalıplı eylem birbirinden ayrılarak tanımlanır.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişiyi yakalayıp hareket özgürlüğünü elinden alarak tutsak duruma getirmek veya bu durumda bulunan kişiyi belirtmektir.

facets.statement: Bir kişiyi yakalama ve özgürlüğünü kısıtlayarak tutsak etme eylemini anlatır.
Yakalanıp tutsak edilmiş kişi de aynı söz ailesinin bir biçimiyle adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, yakalayıp tutsak etme eylemiyle bu eylemin sonucundaki tutsak kişi adını aynı anlam alanında birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişinin yakalanması ve özgürlüğü alınarak tutsak duruma getirilmesi için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin yakalanıp özgürlüğünden yoksun bırakılmasını korur.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Doğrudan tutsak etme ve bağlayarak hapsetme adayları sınırı en iyi gösterir; öteki adaylar yalnızca baskı, üstünlük veya hapsetme ortamını paylaşır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi göz ve benzeri durumlar için yapılan sözlü bir iyileştirme uygulamasını, büyüye benzetilen nesneyi ve eşin başka kadınlarla birleşmesini engelleme girişimini birlikte verir. Bunların ortak yanı doğaüstü sayılan bir işlemle kişiyi etkilemek veya engellemektir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal doğal hastalığı değil, söz, nesne veya büyüsel düzenekle etkileme ve özellikle cinsel birleşmeyi engelleme inancını anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel doğaüstü etkileme alanı, göz için sözlü uygulama ve eşe yönelik engelleme kalıplarına göre ayrı alt yönlerle verilir.

concept_map.definition: Söz, nesne ya da büyüsel sayılan bir düzenekle göz ve benzeri bir durumu etkilemek veya bir kişiyi, özellikle eşini başka kadınlarla birleşmekten alıkoymaktır.

facets.statement: Doğaüstü etkili sayılan sözlü uygulama veya nesne aracılığıyla bir kişi ya da bedensel durum üzerinde etki kurmayı anlatır.
Özel bir kullanımda kadın, büyüsel sayılan yollarla eşini başka kadınlarla cinsel birleşmeden alıkoymaya çalışır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar göz ve benzeri durumlara yönelen sözlü uygulamayı, büyüsel nesneyi ve eşin cinsel davranışını engellemeyi ortak bir doğaüstü etkileme alanında toplar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Sözlü uygulama, nesne veya büyüsel sayılan yöntemle kişi üzerinde etki kurma ve onu belirli bir davranıştan alıkoyma alanını kapsar.

error_profile.preserves: Doğaüstü sayılan aracı, etki kurmayı ve engelleme sonucunu korur.

error_profile.loses: Göz ve benzeri durumlar için yapılan daha genel sözlü uygulama kapsamını dışarıda bırakır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir kişinin ya da yöneticinin araziyi kendisi için alıp denetimine geçirmesini, mülk edinmesini ve işler duruma getirmesini açıkça bildirir. Dalın arazi ve mülk odağı kaynak sınırına uygundur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam, kişinin kendisi için sahiplenip denetimine aldığı ve işlediği araziyle sınırlıdır; su biriktiren yer bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım tanıklanan yalın arazi adı ve onun edinilip işletilme özellikleriyle sınırlıdır; kalıplaşmış başka okumalardan anlam aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin ya da yöneticinin kendisi için sahiplenip denetimine aldığı, mülk edindiği ve işler duruma getirdiği arazidir.

facets.statement: Kişinin kendisi için sahiplenip denetimine geçirdiği araziyi anlatır.
Arazinin mülk edinilmesi ve işlenerek canlandırılması bu adlandırmanın belirgin sonucudur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, kendisi için alınan araziyi sahiplenme, denetim altına alma, mülk edinme ve işler duruma getirme yönleriyle tanımlar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi suyun toplandığı, gölcüğe benzeyen ve kazılarak suyu günlerce tutabilen yeri ortak çekirdek olarak verir. Dalın havuz, çukur ve su birikme yeri bileşenleri bu yapıyı eksiksiz yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, suyu toplayıp bir süre tutan yer veya yapıdır; sahiplenilmiş arazi anlamı buna karıştırılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, tanıklanan yalın yer adının su toplama ve tutma işleviyle sınırlıdır; başka söz kalıplarından kapsam alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Suyun toplandığı ve bir süre tutulduğu, doğal gölcüğe benzeyebilen ya da havuz biçiminde kazılmış yer veya yapıdır.

facets.statement: Suyu bir yerde toplayıp bir süre tutan çukur, havuz veya benzeri yeri anlatır.
Kaynak anlatımlarında yer kimi zaman gölcüğe benzeyen bir birikinti, kimi zaman kişinin kendisi için kazdığı havuz biçimli bir yapı olarak belirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar suyun toplandığı ve günlerce tutulabildiği yeri ortaklaştırır; anlatım doğal gölcük benzeri yer ile kazılmış havuz biçimi arasında değişir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi hastalığın kişiyi tutması düşüncesini verirken göz yangısı, hastalıktan boyun bükme, yavrunun sütten rahatsızlanması, deve veya koyunda delilik benzeri durum ve devede yağlanmaya başlama gibi farklı bedensel halleri de aynı dalda toplar. Bu nedenle dal yalnızca hastalık diye daraltılmamalı, bedende başlayan veya bedeni etkisi altına alan tanıklanmış durumlar kümesi olarak sınırlandırılmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal tek bir hastalık adı değildir; insan ve hayvanda tanıklanan rahatsızlıklarla devede yağlanmaya başlama durumunu ayrı alt yönler halinde kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Farklı beden durumları yalnızca kendi biçim ve kalıpları içinde korunur; bir alt kullanım bütün dalın genel anlamı yapılmaz.

concept_map.definition: İnsan veya hayvan bedeninde belirli bir durumun başlayıp etkisini göstermesini anlatan kullanımlar kümesidir; göz yangısı ve hastalıktan boyun bükme yanında sütten rahatsızlanma, delilik benzeri hayvan hali ve devede yağlanmaya başlama da tanıklanır.

facets.statement: Bir hastalık ya da beden durumunun insanı veya hayvanı etkisi altına almaya başlamasını anlatan genel bağı kurar.
İnsanda göz yangısını ve hastalık ya da ağrı yüzünden başı eğip boyun bükmüş durumu belirtir.
Deve ve koyunda deliliğe benzeyen bir hali, süt emen yavruda ise fazla sütten doğan rahatsızlığı belirtir.
Develerde yağın oluşmaya başlaması, hastalık dışındaki olumlu bir beden değişimi olarak aynı söz ailesinde yer alır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bedeni etkisi altına alan durum fikrini çeşitli insan ve hayvan örnekleriyle genişletir; göz yangısı, hastalıktan çökkünlük, fazla sütten rahatsızlanma, delilik benzeri hal ve yağlanmaya başlama birlikte tanıklanır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, dalın merkezinde bir araya gelme ile karşılıklı yardım ve destek ilişkisini birlikte gösterir. Ordu, yardımcılar ve aynı türden varlıkların oluşturduğu topluluklar bu merkezin gerçekleşmeleridir; canların kümeler halinde anıldığı söz ile toplanmış topluluk anlatımı ise belirli kuruluşlara bağlı kullanımlardır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, sert ve taşlı araziyi, taşları, yer adlarını ve kişi ya da topluluk adlarını kapsamaz; belirli kuruluşlardaki kullanımlar da çıplak anlamla özdeşleştirilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kapsam hem topluluk, ordu ve destekçiler için bağımsız kullanımları hem de yalnızca belirli söz kuruluşlarında görülen toplanmış veya uyumlarına göre ayrılmış kümeleri içerir; bu iki düzey tanımda ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir amaç, tür veya karşılıklı destek ilişkisi çevresinde bir araya gelmiş topluluk; özellikle orduyu, yardımcıları ve destekçileri anlatır. Belirli söz kuruluşlarında toplanıp düzenlenmiş bir topluluğa veya uyumlarına göre birleşen ya da ayrışan can kümelerine uygulanır.

facets.statement: Temel anlam, ortak bir bağ çevresinde toplanmış ve üyeleri birbirine destek olabilen bir topluluktur.
Ordu ile bir kimsenin yardımcıları ve destekçileri, bu topluluk anlamının başlıca özel gerçekleşmeleridir.
Aynı türden varlıkların ayrı bir sınıf halinde oluşturduğu topluluk da bu adla anılabilir.
Belirli kuruluşlarda söz, toplanıp düzenlenmiş bir topluluğu veya uyumlarına göre birleşen ve ayrışan can kümelerini niteler.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak anlatımı, bir araya gelmiş topluluğu karşılıklı yardım ve destek bağıyla ilişkilendirir; orduyu, yardımcıları, destekçileri ve her türden topluluğu bu alan içinde gösterir. Toplanıp düzenlenmiş topluluk ve canların uyumlarına göre kümelenmesi belirli söz kuruluşlarında yer alır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın toplanma ve karşılıklı destekten oluşan çekirdeğini birlikte belirtir; ordu, yardımcılar ve daha genel topluluk kullanımlarını tek bir üst anlatımda karşılar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, kumaşın, başka bir malın ya da bir taşın atılmasını satışın bağlayıcı hale geldiğini gösteren işlem olarak tanımlar. Dal çerçevesi bu özel satış düzenini doğru verir ve onu genel atma anlamından ayırır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnızca atma hareketinin satışı kesinleştiren işaret sayıldığı özel işlem için geçerlidir; genel satış veya genel atma anlamına genişletilemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca belirli satış söz öbeğine bağlıdır; atma eylemine veya bütün satış türlerine yalın bir kök anlamı olarak yüklenmez.

facets.statement: Belirli bir nesneyi karşı tarafa atma hareketi, satış iradesini gösteren işlem işlevi görür.

Atılan şey kumaş, başka bir ticaret malı veya bu amaçla kullanılan bir taş olabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak kaynak özeti yoktur; bu özel satış işlemi eldeki kanıtta tek bir sözlükçe tanıklanmıştır.

source_details.summary: Kumaşın, malın veya taşın atılması satışın kesinleşme işareti sayılır ve işlem bu hareketle bağlayıcı hale gelir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kısa adlandırmanın yeterli olduğu ve atışın hangi nesneyle yapıldığının bağlamdan anlaşıldığı durumlarda kullanılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi mal, otlak, saç ağarması, yağmur ve yaş meyve gibi varlıkların az miktarını; ayrıca güzel kokulu maddelerden küçük bir parçayı anlatır. Dal çerçevesi doğrudur, ancak az miktar bildiren söz öbekleri ile küçük parça bildiren ad kullanımı ayrı tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam genel küçüklük değildir; belirli söz öbeklerinde az miktarı, yalın ad kullanımında ise belirli maddelerden küçük bir parçayı bildirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Az miktar anlamı çoğunlukla belirli tamlayıcılı söz öbeklerine bağlıdır; küçük parça anlamındaki yalın ad yüzü bunlarla karıştırılmadan ayrıca korunur.

concept_map.definition: Belirli söz öbeklerinde mal, otlak, saç ağarması, yağmur veya yaş meyve gibi bir şeyin az miktarını belirtir. Yalın ad kullanımında ise güzel kokulu maddelerden küçük bir parçayı anlatır.

facets.statement: Bir varlığın bütününe göre az ve sınırlı bir miktarı belirtilir.
Az miktar kullanımı mal, otlak, saçtaki aklık, yağmur ve salkımdaki yaş meyve için tanıklanır.
Ad biçimi, güzel kokulu maddelerden küçük bir parça için de kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar az miktar anlamını çeşitli varlıklarla kurulan söz öbeklerinde ortaklaştırır; kanıt ayrıca güzel kokulu maddelerden küçük bir parça kullanımını da içerir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Tamlayıcılı kullanımlarda az miktarı, yalın ad kullanımında ise tanıklanan maddelerden küçük bir parçayı karşılar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi hurma veya kuru üzümün bir kaba ya da su tulumuna bırakılıp üzerine su dökülmesiyle hazırlanan içeceği ve onu hazırlama eylemini verir. Dal çerçevesi ürün ile hazırlama sürecini doğru biçimde birlikte taşır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal her türlü suda bekletme veya her meyveli içecek için kullanılmaz; hurma ya da kuru üzümün kaba konup su eklenmesiyle hazırlanan ürün ve eylemle sınırlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: İçeceği adlandıran biçim ile onu hazırlama anlamındaki söz öbeği ayrı yüzlerdir; hazırlama kalıbı genel atma veya genel içecek anlamına genişletilmez.

concept_gloss.text: küçük yanlış veya yanlışı işlemeden ona yaklaşma

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ağır kötülüklerden ayrı tutulan düşük dereceli yanlışların adlandırıldığı bağlamda kullanılır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin yanlışın sınırına geldiği, fakat onu gerçekleştirmediği anlatımda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yaklaşmayı, gerçekleştirmemeyi ve sonradan geri durmayı korur.
error_profile.loses: İşlenmiş küçük yanlışların ad olarak belirtilmesi görünümünü dışarıda bırakır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, görünmeyen varlıkların dokunmasına bağlanan etkilenmeyi, hafif bir akıl bozukluğu görünümünü ve bu durumdaki kişiyi aynı dalda açıkça verir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal zararlı bakıştan ve yaşamın ağır olaylarından ayrıdır; yalnız atfedilen dokunma ve akıl etkilenmesi alanındadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, adlaşmış hafif akıl bozukluğu görünümünü dokunma ve etkilenmiş kişi bildiren kalıplardan ayırarak korur.

concept_map.definition: Görünmeyen bir varlığın dokunmasına bağlanan ruhsal ya da zihinsel etkilenme ve bunun hafif bir akıl bozukluğu görünümü olarak belirmesidir.

facets.statement: Kişinin durumu görünmeyen bir varlığın dokunmasıyla açıklanır.

Bu etkilenmeyi taşıdığı düşünülen kişi ayrıca adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, görünmeyen bir varlığa bağlanan dokunma ile hafif akıl bozukluğu görünümünü bir arada sunar ve bu durumdaki kişi için de bir niteleme verir.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Dokunma düşüncesi, genel akıl karışıklığı ve zihin bozulmasıyla açıklanan daha geniş bir alanı kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Aklın, düşüncenin ve gönlün bozulması; hastalık ya da sevgi gibi başka nedenler de kapsanır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi saçın kulak memesini geçmesini, omuzlara yaklaşmasını ve omuzlara ulaştığında başka bir adla anılmasını açık bir uzunluk sınırı olarak verir.
